headline: Amending Inclusionary Zoning ordinance (MCC 12.12.300) under City Council papers 335-26 and 335A-26.
summary: The committee will discuss ordinance 335-26, which would rewrite the Inclusionary Zoning section of the Malden City Code (MCC 12.12.300), and ordinance 335A-26, which would add a new sub-section F titled INCENTIVES to that same code section.
items: Discuss 335-26: rewrite Inclusionary Zoning ordinance (MCC 12.12.300) in its entirety
Review attachments for 335-26, including IZ Study Report, IZ Feasibility Study by RKG, Planning Board reports, and City Planner memo dated 10.15.26
Discuss 335A-26: add new sub-section F. INCENTIVES to Inclusionary Zoning ordinance (MCC 12.12.300)
Review attachments for 335A-26, including OSPCD slides and City Planner memo dated 10.15.26
location: Room 105, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148
